_readme: Hand-labeled before any model run. label.category = expected primary; label.accept = other acceptable primaries for genuinely ambiguous mail; label.alert: true = must alert, false = should not need an alert, null = either is fine; label.skip = expected skip reason. Fictional people and company.

msg.subject: Invoice for October
msg.text:
Hi, our accountant needs a copy of the October invoice for our Pro plan. Where can I download it?

Thanks,
Dana

msg.subject: Feedback after 6 months
msg.text: We've used Tidewell for six months. The booking page is lovely and clients like the reminders. The calendar view is a bit cluttered on small screens and I wish there was a way to colour-code services. Our receptionist also struggled with the reports page at first. All that said, we've decided to move to another tool since we're merging with a larger practice. We paid for the annual plan three weeks ago, so we'd like the unused part of that back.
